title: Requirement-set sign-off outcomes
description: The answers a signer may give when a requirements document (a requirement set, or one of its members) is put to them for sign-off. Declared by the requirement-set callers of Process_Adjudication — crdm-signoff.bpmn's BA_Signoff and crdm-close.bpmn's BA_Confirm — and by spec-kit's adjudicated status. Each answer is recorded as a `requirement-signoff` attestation before anything follows it.

source.note: FR-013 of the RequirementSet amendment; approved by the owner 2026-10-07

codes.label: Approve
codes.definition: The set (or member) is agreed as written. On the set, this moves it to `approved` — or, at close-out, to `accepted`.

codes.label: Approve with amendments
codes.definition: Agreed with the changes the reason states. The document is revised to carry them before any work starts on what changed.

codes.label: Reject
codes.definition: Not agreed. On the set, this moves it to `rejected`; the reason says why, so the next proposal does not repeat it.

codes.label: Defer
codes.definition: Neither agreed nor refused now. The set keeps its stage; the reason says what it waits on.

codes.label: Cancel
codes.definition: The work is withdrawn. On the set, this moves it to `cancelled`, and a cancellation without a reason is refused by `check:requirements`.
